name: MyPadi
tagline: A general-purpose AI assistant on Telegram that pays for real services as it works.
description: MyPadi is a general-purpose AI assistant on Telegram. Describe a task in plain language and MyPadi plans the steps, pays for real external services over x402 on Celo (via buy), checks the results, and returns a sourced answer. It researches topics across X, Reddit, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok (with video transcripts), finds open opportunities like hackathons and grants, investigates Celo on-chain activity, searches flights, summarizes documents you send, and runs standing watches that alert you when something new appears. Users never touch a wallet; the project wallet sponsors usage under strict per-task, per-user and global budget caps.
capabilities: Multi-source intelligence reports across X, Reddit, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok, with video transcripts, sources and confidence notes
Opportunity discovery: open hackathons, grants, bounties and airdrops with deadlines, eligibility and how to apply
Celo on-chain investigation: wallet and transaction lookups, token balances, contract reads, gas and fees
Flight search across routes and dates
Document summaries from uploaded text files
Watchtower: standing watches that re-check a topic on a schedule and alert on new results
Competitor and jobs research on LinkedIn
